_about: Coaching knowledge base for the LLM interpretation layer. One vetted explainer card per biomechanical indicator, plus a controlled glossary. The LLM narrates ONLY from these cards/glosses — it must not invent golf terminology or mechanics from its own knowledge. Cards are intentionally neutral/descriptive (MVP scope: no fix-it advice). Author/review: pending coach sign-off.

indicator card.label: short friendly label shown to the user
indicator card.measures: what the number physically measures (one sentence, plain)
indicator card.why: why it matters to a golfer (one sentence, plain, non-prescriptive)
indicator card.in_range_phrasing: approved description when the metric is inside the tour band
indicator card.out_low_phrasing: approved neutral description when below the tour band (null if not noteworthy low)
indicator card.out_high_phrasing: approved neutral description when above the tour band (null if not noteworthy high)
indicator card.glosses: term -> approved short gloss, for any jargon used in this card

glossary.tour range: the typical spread of values seen across professional tour swings
glossary.tour median: the middle value among professional tour swings
glossary.address: the setup position, just before the swing starts
glossary.top: the top of the backswing, where the club changes direction
glossary.impact: the instant the club meets the ball
glossary.backswing: the takeaway and turn back, away from the target
glossary.downswing: the move from the top of the backswing down to the ball
glossary.percentile: where this swing sits relative to tour pros — e.g. 30th percentile means 30% of pros are lower

shoulder_turn_top_deg.label: Shoulder turn
shoulder_turn_top_deg.plain_name: how far the shoulders rotate at the top
shoulder_turn_top_deg.measures: how far the shoulders have rotated away from the target at the top of the backswing
shoulder_turn_top_deg.why: shoulder rotation is the main way the body coils to store energy for the downswing
shoulder_turn_top_deg.in_range_phrasing: the shoulders rotate about as far as a typical tour swing at the top
shoulder_turn_top_deg.out_low_phrasing: the shoulders rotate less than most tour swings at the top
shoulder_turn_top_deg.out_high_phrasing: the shoulders rotate further than most tour swings at the top

glosses.coil: the wind-up of the body during the backswing that stores energy

hip_turn_top_deg.label: Hip turn at the top
hip_turn_top_deg.plain_name: how far the hips rotate at the top
hip_turn_top_deg.measures: how far the hips have rotated away from the target at the top of the backswing
hip_turn_top_deg.why: the hips turn alongside the shoulders during the backswing; the difference between the two creates separation
hip_turn_top_deg.in_range_phrasing: the hips rotate about as far as a typical tour swing at the top
hip_turn_top_deg.out_low_phrasing: the hips rotate less than most tour swings at the top
hip_turn_top_deg.out_high_phrasing: the hips rotate further than most tour swings at the top

x_factor_top_deg.label: X-factor (shoulder–hip separation)
x_factor_top_deg.plain_name: the gap between shoulder turn and hip turn at the top
x_factor_top_deg.measures: the difference between how far the shoulders turn and how far the hips turn at the top
x_factor_top_deg.why: this separation is a big part of how the body stores and releases power
x_factor_top_deg.in_range_phrasing: the separation between shoulders and hips is about typical for a tour swing
x_factor_top_deg.out_low_phrasing: there is less separation between the shoulders and hips than in most tour swings
x_factor_top_deg.out_high_phrasing: there is more separation between the shoulders and hips than in most tour swings

glosses.X-factor: the gap between how far the shoulders turn and how far the hips turn
glosses.separation: the difference between shoulder turn and hip turn

hip_turn_impact_deg.label: Hip rotation at impact
hip_turn_impact_deg.plain_name: how open the hips are at impact
hip_turn_impact_deg.measures: how far the hips have rotated open toward the target at the moment of impact
hip_turn_impact_deg.why: the hips lead the body's rotation through the ball
hip_turn_impact_deg.in_range_phrasing: the hips are about as open at impact as a typical tour swing
hip_turn_impact_deg.out_low_phrasing: the hips are less open at impact than most tour swings
hip_turn_impact_deg.out_high_phrasing: the hips are more open at impact than most tour swings

glosses.open hips: hips rotated to face more toward the target

spine_tilt_address_deg.label: Spine angle at address
spine_tilt_address_deg.plain_name: how much the upper body leans at setup
spine_tilt_address_deg.measures: how far the spine is tilted away from vertical at the setup position
spine_tilt_address_deg.why: the spine angle at setup sets the posture the swing is built around
spine_tilt_address_deg.in_range_phrasing: the upper body leans about as much as a typical tour swing at setup
spine_tilt_address_deg.out_low_phrasing: the upper body leans less than most tour swings at setup
spine_tilt_address_deg.out_high_phrasing: the upper body leans more than most tour swings at setup

glosses.spine angle: how much the upper body leans forward from standing upright

spine_tilt_impact_deg.label: Spine angle at impact
spine_tilt_impact_deg.plain_name: how much the upper body leans at impact
spine_tilt_impact_deg.measures: how far the spine is tilted away from vertical at the moment of impact
spine_tilt_impact_deg.why: keeping a similar posture from setup to impact helps the swing stay on plane
spine_tilt_impact_deg.in_range_phrasing: the upper body leans about as much at impact as a typical tour swing
spine_tilt_impact_deg.out_low_phrasing: the upper body leans less at impact than most tour swings
spine_tilt_impact_deg.out_high_phrasing: the upper body leans more at impact than most tour swings

glosses.spine angle: how much the upper body leans forward from standing upright

posture_loss_deg.label: Posture (spine angle change)
posture_loss_deg.plain_name: how much the spine angle changes from setup to impact
posture_loss_deg.measures: how much the spine angle changes between setup and impact
posture_loss_deg.why: tour swings tend to hold their setup posture fairly well into impact
posture_loss_deg.in_range_phrasing: the posture holds about as steadily from setup to impact as a typical tour swing
posture_loss_deg.out_high_phrasing: the spine angle changes more from setup to impact than in most tour swings, meaning the posture shifts during the swing

glosses.posture: the spine and body angle held during the swing
glosses.early extension: standing up out of the setup posture during the downswing

head_sway_max_pct.label: Head sway
head_sway_max_pct.plain_name: how much the head drifts sideways
head_sway_max_pct.measures: the most the head drifts sideways during the swing, as a share of body size
head_sway_max_pct.why: a stable head helps keep the low point of the swing consistent
head_sway_max_pct.in_range_phrasing: the head stays about as steady side-to-side as a typical tour swing
head_sway_max_pct.out_low_phrasing: the head moves less side-to-side than most tour swings
head_sway_max_pct.out_high_phrasing: the head drifts further side-to-side than most tour swings

glosses.sway: sideways movement of the head or body away from the ball

head_lift_max_pct.label: Head height change
head_lift_max_pct.plain_name: how much the head moves up and down
head_lift_max_pct.measures: the most the head moves up or down during the swing, as a share of body size
head_lift_max_pct.why: a steady head height helps the club return to the ball consistently
head_lift_max_pct.in_range_phrasing: the head stays about as steady in height as a typical tour swing
head_lift_max_pct.out_low_phrasing: the head moves less up-and-down than most tour swings
head_lift_max_pct.out_high_phrasing: the head moves more up-and-down than most tour swings

left_arm_bend_top_deg.label: Lead-arm extension
left_arm_bend_top_deg.plain_name: how straight the lead arm is at the top
left_arm_bend_top_deg.measures: how straight or bent the lead arm is at the top of the backswing
left_arm_bend_top_deg.why: lead-arm extension relates to the width and structure of the backswing
left_arm_bend_top_deg.in_range_phrasing: the lead arm is about as extended at the top as a typical tour swing
left_arm_bend_top_deg.out_low_phrasing: the lead arm is more bent at the top than most tour swings

glosses.lead arm: the arm closer to the target (left arm for a right-handed golfer)
glosses.width: how far the hands and club stay from the body during the backswing

right_arm_bend_top_deg.label: Trail-arm position
right_arm_bend_top_deg.plain_name: how the trail arm folds at the top
right_arm_bend_top_deg.measures: how much the trail arm folds at the top of the backswing
right_arm_bend_top_deg.why: the trail arm folds to support the club at the top of the backswing
right_arm_bend_top_deg.in_range_phrasing: the trail arm folds about as much at the top as a typical tour swing
right_arm_bend_top_deg.out_low_phrasing: the trail arm folds less at the top than most tour swings
right_arm_bend_top_deg.out_high_phrasing: the trail arm folds more at the top than most tour swings

glosses.trail arm: the arm farther from the target (right arm for a right-handed golfer)

lead_knee_flex_address_deg.label: Lead-knee flex at address
lead_knee_flex_address_deg.plain_name: how bent the lead knee is at setup
lead_knee_flex_address_deg.measures: how much the lead knee is bent at the setup position
lead_knee_flex_address_deg.why: knee flex at setup is part of an athletic, balanced stance
lead_knee_flex_address_deg.in_range_phrasing: the lead knee is bent about as much at setup as a typical tour swing
lead_knee_flex_address_deg.out_low_phrasing: the lead knee is more bent at setup than most tour swings
lead_knee_flex_address_deg.out_high_phrasing: the lead knee is straighter at setup than most tour swings

glosses.lead knee: the knee closer to the target (left knee for a right-handed golfer)
glosses.flex: how much a joint is bent

lead_knee_flex_impact_deg.label: Lead-knee flex at impact
lead_knee_flex_impact_deg.plain_name: how bent the lead knee is at impact
lead_knee_flex_impact_deg.measures: how much the lead knee is bent at the moment of impact
lead_knee_flex_impact_deg.why: many tour players straighten the lead leg into impact as part of releasing power
lead_knee_flex_impact_deg.in_range_phrasing: the lead knee is bent about as much at impact as a typical tour swing
lead_knee_flex_impact_deg.out_low_phrasing: the lead knee is more bent at impact than most tour swings
lead_knee_flex_impact_deg.out_high_phrasing: the lead knee is straighter at impact than most tour swings

glosses.lead knee: the knee closer to the target (left knee for a right-handed golfer)

hip_lateral_shift_pct.label: Weight shift
hip_lateral_shift_pct.plain_name: how much the hips slide toward the target
hip_lateral_shift_pct.measures: how far the hips slide sideways toward the target from setup to impact, as a share of body size
hip_lateral_shift_pct.why: some sideways hip drive toward the target is part of transferring weight through the ball
hip_lateral_shift_pct.in_range_phrasing: the hips slide toward the target about as much as a typical tour swing
hip_lateral_shift_pct.out_low_phrasing: the hips slide toward the target less than most tour swings
hip_lateral_shift_pct.out_high_phrasing: the hips slide sideways more than most tour swings

glosses.weight shift: moving body weight toward the target through the downswing

tempo_ratio.label: Tempo (backswing : downswing)
tempo_ratio.measures: how long the backswing takes compared with the downswing
tempo_ratio.why: many tour swings settle near a 3-to-1 backswing-to-downswing rhythm
tempo_ratio.in_range_phrasing: the swing rhythm is close to the tour-typical pace
tempo_ratio.out_low_phrasing: the backswing-to-downswing rhythm is quicker than the roughly 3-to-1 tour norm
tempo_ratio.out_high_phrasing: the backswing is longer relative to the downswing than the roughly 3-to-1 tour norm

glosses.tempo: the timing and rhythm of the swing
glosses.3-to-1: a backswing about three times as long as the downswing

hand_speed_impact_bs.label: Hand speed into impact
hand_speed_impact_bs.plain_name: how fast the hands move into the ball
hand_speed_impact_bs.measures: the peak speed of the hands through the hitting zone, normalized by body size
hand_speed_impact_bs.why: faster hands into the ball generally carry more clubhead speed and distance
hand_speed_impact_bs.in_range_phrasing: the hands move through impact at a tour-typical pace
hand_speed_impact_bs.out_low_phrasing: the hands move into impact slower than tour-typical
hand_speed_impact_bs.out_high_phrasing: the hands move into impact faster than tour-typical

glosses.hand speed: how quickly the hands travel through the hitting area, measured relative to body size
